text.tspan: Corrected: account → region → VPC → 3 AZs × 3 subnet tiers, with the NAT gateway INSIDE a public subnet
one per VPC, at its edge
Route tables: what makes a subnet public or private
PRIVATE app (one per AZ): 10.0.0.0/16 → local · 0.0.0.0/0 → the NAT gateway in the SAME AZ
PRIVATE data: 10.0.0.0/16 → local only (a database needs no internet)
Subnets never overlap: each one has its own range and lives in exactly one AZ (Availability Zone). Free space is left for growth (10.0.64.0 – 10.0.255.255).
In real life take a unique VPC range from IPAM (IP Address Manager), never the default 10.0.0.0/16 everyone uses.
